title: 3DS: the network is built, and the first real sign-in is pending
body: The 3DS shares the Wii U's social services: friends, friend requests and notifications run on OpenPak and are tested against our live account core. The 3DS sign-in client is built, and what remains is the step only a real 3DS can prove: one sign-in from a console. Identity is only partly finished, because the 3DS Mii part is still missing. Twenty-six 3DS titles are in beta testing and thirteen more can be requested from the catalogue.
footer: OpenPak Networks — built in the open.
